destinations.name: Costa del Sol
destinations.blurb: Marbella's golden beaches, whitewashed hill villages and sunshine for most of the year.

destinations.name: Tenerife
destinations.blurb: Winter-sun beaches, Mount Teide's lunar landscape and whale-watching off the south coast.

destinations.name: Seville
destinations.blurb: Orange-scented streets, the Alcázar, flamenco and the grand Plaza de España.

destinations.name: Costa Blanca
destinations.blurb: Long sandy beaches, lively Benidorm and quieter coves around Jávea and Altea.

destinations.name: Granada
destinations.blurb: The Alhambra's Moorish palaces below the snowy Sierra Nevada, with free tapas alongside every drink.

destinations.name: Lanzarote
destinations.blurb: Black volcanic landscapes, César Manrique's art and dependable sunshine all year round.

destinations.name: Madrid
destinations.blurb: The Prado, Retiro Park and late-night tapas bars in Spain's grand capital.

destinations.name: San Sebastián
destinations.blurb: A curving city beach, pintxos bars and more Michelin stars per head than almost anywhere.

destinations.name: Tallinn
destinations.blurb: Northern Europe's best-preserved medieval old town, with Gothic towers, craft shops and a buzzing food scene.

destinations.name: Saaremaa
destinations.blurb: Windmills, juniper meadows, Kuressaare's bishops' castle and the Kaali meteorite crater.

destinations.name: Pärnu
destinations.blurb: Estonia's summer capital, with a long sandy beach, mud spas and relaxed seafront cafes.

destinations.name: Tartu
destinations.blurb: Student city of riverside strolls, cheerful bars and one of northern Europe's oldest universities.

destinations.name: Lahemaa National Park
destinations.blurb: Bogs, rocky coast and fine manor houses such as Palmse, about an hour from Tallinn.

destinations.name: Hiiumaa
destinations.blurb: Quiet island of pine forest, lighthouses and long sandy beaches.

destinations.name: Addis Ababa
destinations.blurb: Highland capital of coffee ceremonies, the Lucy fossil at the National Museum and the huge Merkato market.

destinations.name: Bale Mountains National Park
destinations.blurb: Afro-alpine plateau for hiking and horse trekking, with Ethiopian wolves and mountain nyala.

destinations.name: Harar
destinations.blurb: A walled Muslim city of 82 mosques and winding alleys, where hyena men feed wild hyenas by hand after dark.

destinations.name: Arba Minch and the Rift Valley Lakes
destinations.blurb: Crocodile boat trips on Lake Chamo and views over the 'Bridge of God' between two lakes.

destinations.name: Hawassa
destinations.blurb: Lakeside promenade, marabou storks at the fish market and monkeys in Tikur Wuha forest.

destinations.name: Helsinki
destinations.blurb: Design district, Suomenlinna sea fortress, harbourside market hall and saunas by the sea.

destinations.name: Rovaniemi
destinations.blurb: Santa Claus Village on the Arctic Circle, with huskies, reindeer and northern lights.

destinations.name: Levi
destinations.blurb: Lapland's top ski and snowmobile resort, with husky safaris, glass igloos and aurora hunting.

destinations.blurb: Fell-top trails of Urho Kekkonen National Park, Sámi culture and northern lights from glass igloos.

destinations.name: Savonlinna and Lake Saimaa
destinations.blurb: Olavinlinna castle on an island in a maze of lakes, with an opera festival every July.

destinations.blurb: Finland's oldest city on the River Aura with a medieval castle, and island-hopping in the archipelago.

destinations.name: Porvoo
destinations.blurb: Red wooden riverside warehouses and a cobbled old town, an easy day trip east of Helsinki.

destinations.name: Tampere
destinations.blurb: Lakeside red-brick mill town with public saunas, the Moomin Museum and the Särkänniemi observation tower.

destinations.name: Mamanuca Islands
destinations.blurb: Sheltered coral islands just off Nadi, with lagoon snorkelling, island resorts and sunset cruises.

destinations.name: Yasawa Islands
destinations.blurb: Remote volcanic islands of white sand, blue lagoons and simple beach bures, reached by catamaran.

destinations.name: Denarau Island
destinations.blurb: Fiji's resort enclave, with family hotels, golf, spas and easy transfers from Nadi airport.

destinations.name: Coral Coast
destinations.blurb: Fringing reefs, sand dunes and village life along Viti Levu's sunny southern shore.

destinations.name: Taveuni
destinations.blurb: The Garden Island, with rainforest waterfalls, hiking and the world-class Rainbow Reef nearby.

destinations.name: Savusavu
destinations.blurb: A hot-spring harbour town on Vanua Levu, with pearl farms, diving and quiet bay-view stays.

destinations.name: Suva
destinations.blurb: Fiji's lively capital, with a colourful municipal market, museum and Colo-i-Suva rainforest park.

destinations.name: Stanley
destinations.blurb: A cosy British-feeling capital of red phone boxes, pubs and battlefield tours.

destinations.name: Volunteer Point
destinations.blurb: A large king penguin colony on a white-sand beach, reached by rugged 4x4 track.

destinations.name: Sea Lion Island
destinations.blurb: Elephant seals, sea lions and orcas hunting off the shore, with penguins on every walk.

destinations.name: Saunders Island
destinations.blurb: Rockhopper and gentoo penguins and black-browed albatross on dramatic cliffs.

destinations.blurb: One of the world's smallest capitals, with a turf-roofed old town and harbour cafes, and the base for the islands.

destinations.blurb: Múlafossur waterfall tumbling into the Atlantic, near the airport and the Sørvágsvatn lake trail.

destinations.name: Mykines

destinations.blurb: A turf-roofed church by a tidal lagoon in a cliff-framed valley, at the end of a winding road.

destinations.name: Yap
destinations.blurb: Hand-carved stone money, traditional villages and diving with manta rays through the channels.

destinations.blurb: A quiet, green island of mangrove kayaking, lush trails, snorkelling and the Leluh ruins.

destinations.blurb: Nice's Promenade des Anglais, Cannes, Antibes and perched villages behind a sparkling Mediterranean.

destinations.blurb: Lavender fields, hilltop villages like Gordes, Roman remains, market towns and rosé at lunch.

destinations.name: Dordogne
destinations.blurb: Honey-stone chateaux, canoeing on the river, Sarlat's market, truffles and prehistoric caves.

destinations.name: Bordeaux
destinations.blurb: Elegant riverside city, with the great vineyards of Saint-Émilion and the Médoc on its doorstep.

destinations.name: Corsica
destinations.blurb: Mountainous Mediterranean island of hidden coves, granite peaks and Bonifacio's clifftop old town.

destinations.blurb: Balconied old-town streets, sulphur baths, hilltop fortresses and a thriving food and wine scene.

destinations.name: Zakynthos

destinations.name: Kos

destinations.blurb: The Acropolis and Parthenon above a lively city of rooftop bars and tavernas.

destinations.name: Kefalonia

destinations.name: Mykonos
destinations.blurb: Windmills, whitewashed lanes and stylish beach clubs around Little Venice.

destinations.name: Meteora
destinations.blurb: Monasteries perched on giant rock pillars, best seen at sunrise or sunset.

destinations.name: Grand Etang and Annandale Falls
destinations.blurb: Crater-lake rainforest with mona monkeys, waterfall swims and nutmeg plantations.

destinations.name: Ilulissat Icefjord

destinations.name: South Greenland

destinations.name: Iwokrama Rainforest

destinations.name: Georgetown

destinations.name: Hong Kong Island

destinations.name: Kowloon
destinations.blurb: The Tsim Sha Tsui promenade, Temple Street night market and neon-lit Mong Kok.

destinations.name: Lantau Island
destinations.blurb: The Big Buddha, a cable car over the hills and hiking trails and beaches away from the city.

destinations.name: Sai Kung
destinations.blurb: Seafood on the quayside, hidden beaches, volcanic geopark coast and hiking in the country parks.

destinations.name: Lamma Island
destinations.blurb: A car-free island of seafood restaurants, hikes and quiet beaches, a short ferry from Central.

destinations.name: Utila

destinations.name: La Ceiba and Pico Bonito

destinations.name: Lake Yojoa
destinations.blurb: Honduras's largest lake, with birdwatching, coffee farms and waterfall walks.

destinations.name: Dubrovnik
destinations.blurb: Walk the medieval city walls above the Adriatic, then take the cable car for the view.

destinations.name: Split

destinations.name: Hvar
destinations.blurb: Lavender fields, a Venetian harbour and sunny beach clubs on a glamorous island.

destinations.name: Plitvice Lakes

destinations.name: Rovinj and Istria

destinations.name: Korčula

destinations.name: Zadar

destinations.name: Makarska Riviera

destinations.name: Jacmel

destinations.name: Port-Salut

destinations.name: Île-à-Vache

destinations.name: Budapest
destinations.blurb: Thermal baths, a grand Parliament and ruin bars on either side of the Danube.

destinations.name: Lake Balaton
destinations.blurb: Central Europe's largest lake, with Tihany's abbey, vineyards and warm summer swims.

destinations.name: Eger

destinations.name: Tokaj

destinations.name: Pécs

destinations.name: Szentendre and the Danube Bend
destinations.blurb: A cobbled artists' town beside the Danube's dramatic bend, close to Budapest.

destinations.blurb: Liveaboard cruises to see Komodo dragons, pink beaches and manta rays from Labuan Bajo.

destinations.name: Lombok

destinations.name: Mount Bromo

destinations.name: Raja Ampat

destinations.name: Tanjung Puting

destinations.name: Bunaken

destinations.name: Douglas

destinations.name: Peel

destinations.name: Castletown

destinations.name: Port Erin

destinations.name: Udaipur

destinations.name: Rishikesh

destinations.name: Jaisalmer

destinations.name: Christmas Island

destinations.blurb: An old Red Sea trading port with Ottoman-era buildings and empty beaches on the Gulf of Aden.

destinations.name: Sheikh
destinations.blurb: A cool hill town in the Golis Mountains with colonial-era buildings and views over the coastal plain.

destinations.name: Mogadishu
destinations.blurb: Indian Ocean capital with the long Lido Beach and the old Hamar Weyne district.

destinations.name: Kismayo
destinations.blurb: Indian Ocean port city with miles of empty beaches.

destinations.name: Bosaso
destinations.blurb: Puntland's Gulf of Aden port, with a busy seafront and fish market.

destinations.name: Saint-Pierre
destinations.blurb: A tiny slice of France off Newfoundland, with baguettes, brightly painted houses and a harbour.

destinations.name: Miquelon-Langlade
destinations.blurb: Wild dunes, seals and free-roaming horses on the larger, quieter island.

destinations.name: Ile-aux-Marins
destinations.blurb: An abandoned fishing village on a little island, a short boat trip across the bay.

destinations.name: Belgrade
destinations.blurb: A rugged, charming capital of riverside clubs, a vast fortress and bohemian Skadarlija cafés.

destinations.name: Novi Sad
destinations.blurb: Habsburg-era streets, Petrovaradin Fortress above the Danube and café-lined squares.

destinations.name: Tara National Park
destinations.blurb: Dense forests, Drina river viewpoints and wildlife in Western Serbia.

destinations.name: Zlatibor
destinations.blurb: Rolling pine-clad mountains for walking, cosy spas and winter skiing.

destinations.name: Fruška Gora
destinations.blurb: Forested hills dotted with Orthodox monasteries, vineyards and spa villages.

destinations.name: Príncipe
destinations.blurb: A UNESCO biosphere island of jungle, volcanic spires and empty beaches where turtles nest.

destinations.name: São Tomé Island
destinations.blurb: Cocoa plantations (roças), crater lake hikes and turtle-nesting beaches like Praia Jalé.

destinations.name: Ilhéu das Rolas
destinations.blurb: Stand on the equator at the monument on a tiny southern island fringed with coral.

destinations.name: Paramaribo
destinations.blurb: Dutch wooden colonial architecture beside mosques and synagogues, a UNESCO-listed capital.

destinations.name: Brownsberg Nature Park
destinations.blurb: Rainforest plateau above a vast lake, with waterfalls and howler monkeys at dawn.

destinations.name: Commewijne Plantations
destinations.blurb: Old Dutch plantations and river dolphins, a short ferry from Paramaribo.

destinations.name: Galibi Nature Reserve
destinations.blurb: Remote beaches where giant leatherback turtles nest between February and August.

destinations.name: Bratislava
destinations.blurb: A compact Danube capital with a pastel old town, hilltop castle and café terraces.

destinations.name: High Tatras
destinations.blurb: Slovakia's jagged alpine peaks, with mountain lakes, hut-to-hut hikes and ski runs.

destinations.name: Košice
destinations.blurb: The Gothic St Elisabeth Cathedral, pastel façades and lively street life in the east.

destinations.name: Banská Štiavnica
destinations.blurb: A UNESCO silver-mining town of steep lanes, castles and old mining lakes.

destinations.name: Spiš Castle and Levoča
destinations.blurb: One of Europe's largest castle complexes, above a medieval walled town.

destinations.name: Slovak Paradise
destinations.blurb: Canyons with ladders, chains and waterfalls on an exhilarating walking trail.

destinations.name: Lake Bled
destinations.blurb: An island church in a glacial lake below a clifftop castle, with a famous cream cake.

destinations.name: Ljubljana
destinations.blurb: A green, car-free riverside capital with a hilltop castle and Plečnik's elegant bridges.

destinations.name: Piran
destinations.blurb: A Venetian-style seaside town of narrow lanes and fresh seafood on the Adriatic.

destinations.name: Lake Bohinj
destinations.blurb: A quieter alpine lake ringed by Triglav National Park peaks, made for walking and swimming.

destinations.name: Soča Valley
destinations.blurb: An emerald river for rafting, kayaking and hiking beneath the Julian Alps.

destinations.name: Postojna Cave
destinations.blurb: Ride a train through vast limestone caverns, then see Predjama Castle built into a cliff.

destinations.name: Stockholm
destinations.blurb: Capital spread over fourteen islands, with the Vasa Museum, Gamla Stan's lanes and archipelago boat trips.

destinations.name: Abisko
destinations.blurb: Arctic national park and top aurora-watching spot, with the Sky Station and dog-sledding in winter.

destinations.name: Jukkasjärvi and the Icehotel
destinations.blurb: Sleep in rooms carved from ice beside the Torne river, with northern lights, huskies and reindeer sleighs.

destinations.name: Gothenburg
destinations.blurb: Relaxed canal city with fine seafood, the Haga district and ferries out to the southern archipelago.

destinations.name: Gotland and Visby
destinations.blurb: Medieval walled Visby, limestone sea stacks and sandy bays on Sweden's sunniest island.

destinations.name: Dalarna and Lake Siljan
destinations.blurb: Red wooden cottages, maypoles and midsummer traditions around Sweden's heartland lake.

destinations.name: Smögen and the Bohuslän Coast
destinations.blurb: Granite islets, red fishing huts, prawn sandwiches and kayaking along Sweden's rugged west coast.

destinations.name: Malmö
destinations.blurb: Multicultural city across the Öresund bridge from Copenhagen, with the Turning Torso and Skåne's beaches nearby.

destinations.name: Ezulwini Valley and Mlilwane
destinations.blurb: Walk or cycle among zebra and hippos at Mlilwane, then visit cultural villages and craft markets.

destinations.name: Hlane Royal National Park
destinations.blurb: Lions, white rhinos and elephants in the country's largest protected park.

destinations.name: Malolotja Nature Reserve
destinations.blurb: Mountain trails, waterfalls and rare birds in a remote highland reserve.

destinations.name: Mkhaya Game Reserve
destinations.blurb: Intimate game drives to see black and white rhinos from open vehicles and on foot.

destinations.name: Maho Beach
destinations.blurb: Famous for jets landing just overhead; sunbathe, then watch the planes from the Sunset Beach Bar.

destinations.name: Philipsburg
destinations.blurb: Dutch-side capital of Front Street shops, a long boardwalk beach and sunset cruises.

destinations.name: Simpson Bay
destinations.blurb: Lagoon-side restaurants, sunset bars, a good-natured nightlife scene and yachts in Simpson Bay Lagoon.

destinations.name: Mahé
destinations.blurb: Granite-boulder bays like Anse Intendance, mountain forest hikes and the Creole market in Victoria.

destinations.name: Praslin
destinations.blurb: Anse Lazio's postcard beach and the Vallée de Mai's coco de mer palm forest (UNESCO).

destinations.name: La Digue
destinations.blurb: Bikes and ox-carts, Anse Source d'Argent's giant granite boulders and unhurried island life.

destinations.name: Silhouette Island
destinations.blurb: A remote, mostly national-park island with rainforest trails, quiet beaches and rich diving.

destinations.name: Damascus
destinations.blurb: The Umayyad Mosque, covered souks and courtyard houses of one of the world's oldest inhabited cities.

destinations.name: Aleppo
destinations.blurb: A great citadel and a vast covered souk, recovering after years of damage.

destinations.name: Krak des Chevaliers
destinations.blurb: A vast crusader castle on a hilltop, widely seen as one of the best-preserved medieval fortresses.

destinations.name: Palmyra
destinations.blurb: Colonnaded streets and Roman temples in the desert, an oasis city of the ancient world.

destinations.name: Bosra
destinations.blurb: A black-basalt Roman city with a remarkably intact amphitheatre in southern Syria.

destinations.name: Grace Bay
destinations.blurb: Long ribbon of powder-white sand and calm, glassy turquoise sea, with a barrier reef just offshore.

destinations.name: Grand Turk
destinations.blurb: Slow-paced historic island with colonial Cockburn Town, humpback whales in winter and a dramatic wall dive.

destinations.name: Chalk Sound
destinations.blurb: A glowing, almost fluorescent lagoon of tiny cays, perfect for kayaking and paddle-boarding.

destinations.name: Middle Caicos
destinations.blurb: Wild limestone cliffs, empty Mudjin Harbour beach, the Conch Bar Caves and miles of untouched coast.

destinations.name: Salt Cay
destinations.blurb: Sleepy former salt island of ruined salt-works, humpback whales in winter and almost no one else around.

destinations.name: Zakouma National Park
destinations.blurb: A rare wildlife recovery story, with big herds of elephants, giraffes and lions in remote savannah.

destinations.name: N'Djamena
destinations.blurb: Riverside capital on the Chari with a lively central market and a national museum.

destinations.name: Lomé
destinations.blurb: Palm-lined capital on the Gulf of Guinea, with a bustling Grand Marché, a voodoo fetish market and city beaches.

destinations.name: Kpalimé and Mount Agou
destinations.blurb: Cool, forested hill country of waterfalls, butterflies and cocoa farms, with walks up Togo's highest peak.

destinations.name: Togoville and Lake Togo
destinations.blurb: Lakeside voodoo and Catholic pilgrimage town, with pirogue trips to stilted fishing villages.

destinations.name: Koutammakou
destinations.blurb: UNESCO landscape of two-storey mud tower-houses built by the Batammariba, among baobabs and millet fields.

destinations.name: Phuket
destinations.blurb: Kata and Karon beaches, Old Town shophouses and boat trips to the limestone islands of Phang Nga Bay.

destinations.name: Bangkok
destinations.blurb: Gilded temples, tuk-tuks, floating markets and rooftop bars in a thrilling, endlessly tasty capital.

destinations.name: Koh Samui
destinations.blurb: Palm-fringed Chaweng and Lamai beaches, the Big Buddha and quieter coves, with Ang Thong marine park close by.

destinations.name: Krabi and Ao Nang
destinations.blurb: Limestone cliffs, longtail boats to Railay beach and island-hopping to the Phi Phi and Hong islands.

destinations.name: Chiang Mai
destinations.blurb: A moated old city of temples, night bazaars and cooking classes, with ethical elephant sanctuaries in the hills.

destinations.name: Khao Lak
destinations.blurb: Long, quiet golden beaches and boats to the Similan Islands, a calmer alternative to Phuket.

destinations.name: Koh Lanta
destinations.blurb: Laid-back island of long sandy beaches, sunset bars and snorkelling trips to Koh Rok and Koh Ngai.

destinations.name: Hua Hin
destinations.blurb: Thailand's royal seaside resort with night markets, golf courses, vineyards and a lively seafood pier.

destinations.name: Koh Phangan
destinations.blurb: Full Moon Party at Haad Rin, plus yoga retreats, jungle waterfalls and quiet coves in the island's north.

destinations.name: Ayutthaya
destinations.blurb: Crumbling red-brick temples and a Buddha head cradled in banyan roots, a day trip north of Bangkok.

destinations.name: Pamir Highway
destinations.blurb: One of the world's great road trips, with high passes, empty plateaus and Khorog as the Pamir gateway.

destinations.name: Fann Mountains and Iskanderkul
destinations.blurb: Turquoise alpine lakes and jagged peaks, with trekking suitable for families as well as hardy hikers.

destinations.name: Wakhan Valley
destinations.blurb: Ruined fortresses, hot springs and homestays on the Afghan border, beneath the Hindu Kush.

destinations.name: Dushanbe
destinations.blurb: Tree-lined boulevards, teahouses, museums and a giant flagpole in a calm and welcoming capital.

destinations.name: Penjikent
destinations.blurb: Excavated Sogdian city ruins and a lively bazaar close to the Uzbek border.

destinations.name: Darvaza Gas Crater
destinations.blurb: A burning pit in the Karakum desert, the famous Door to Hell, glowing spectacularly at night.

destinations.name: Ashgabat
destinations.blurb: A surreal capital of white marble, golden statues and giant monuments, with Turkmen carpet markets.

destinations.name: Ancient Merv
destinations.blurb: Sprawling UNESCO ruins of a great Silk Road oasis city, with eroded mud-brick walls and mausoleums.

destinations.name: Kunya-Urgench
destinations.blurb: Remote UNESCO-listed ruins of the Khorezmian capital, with domed mausoleums and a tall minaret.

destinations.name: Dili
destinations.blurb: Seafront capital with the Cristo Rei statue, Portuguese colonial buildings and diving at its doorstep.

destinations.name: Atauro Island
destinations.blurb: An island with some of the planet's richest coral, with simple eco-lodges and quiet villages.

destinations.name: Mount Ramelau
destinations.blurb: A pre-dawn climb to the country's highest summit for sunrise above the clouds.

destinations.name: Vava'u Islands
destinations.blurb: Swim with humpback whales between July and October, and sail among over 40 sheltered islands.

destinations.name: Tongatapu
destinations.blurb: Nuku'alofa's royal palace, blowholes at Mapu'a 'a Vaea and secluded southern beaches.

destinations.name: 'Eua Island

destinations.name: Speyside
destinations.blurb: Tobago's wild north-east: Little Tobago bird island, manta-ray diving and quiet coves with rainforest behind.

destinations.name: Maracas Bay
destinations.blurb: The classic Trinidad beach day: sweeping bay, surf and a bake-and-shark sandwich from the roadside stalls.

destinations.name: Asa Wright Nature Centre
destinations.blurb: Birdwatchers' paradise in the Northern Range, with hummingbirds, toucans and oilbirds in the cloud forest.

destinations.name: Caroni Bird Sanctuary
destinations.blurb: Boat through the mangroves at dusk as hundreds of scarlet ibis flock in to roost.

destinations.name: Hammamet
destinations.blurb: Jasmine-scented beach resort with a walled medina and a fort above the calm, shallow Gulf of Hammamet.

destinations.name: Djerba
destinations.blurb: Sunny island of white-sand beaches, whitewashed villages, Guellala potters and the ancient El Ghriba synagogue.

destinations.name: Sousse and Port El Kantaoui
destinations.blurb: Long-time British package favourite with a UNESCO medina, a ribat fortress and a smart marina resort.

destinations.name: Tunis, Carthage and Sidi Bou Said
destinations.blurb: Punic and Roman ruins by the sea, a souk-filled medina and the blue-and-white cliff village of Sidi Bou Said.

destinations.name: Mahdia
destinations.blurb: Quiet fishing port on a rocky peninsula with a Fatimid gate, pale beaches and far fewer crowds than Sousse.

destinations.name: Matmata
destinations.blurb: Berber cave-houses dug into lunar hills, famous as Luke Skywalker's childhood home on Tatooine.

destinations.name: Kairouan
destinations.blurb: Islam's fourth-holiest city, with the vast Great Mosque of Uqba and a medina of carpet-sellers and pastry stalls.

destinations.name: Antalya
destinations.blurb: Old-town Kaleici, Duden waterfalls and miles of Turquoise Coast beaches beneath the Taurus Mountains.

destinations.name: Istanbul
destinations.blurb: Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque and the Grand Bazaar, with Bosphorus ferries between two continents.

destinations.name: Bodrum
destinations.blurb: Whitewashed streets, a crusader castle, lively marinas and sheltered Aegean coves on the Bodrum peninsula.

destinations.name: Marmaris
destinations.blurb: Pine-clad bay with a buzzing marina, boat trips to hidden coves and easy beach days.

destinations.name: Fethiye and Ölüdeniz
destinations.blurb: The Blue Lagoon at Ölüdeniz, paragliding from Babadag and rock-cut tombs above Fethiye harbour.

destinations.name: Cappadocia
destinations.blurb: Fairy chimneys, cave hotels and sunrise hot-air balloons drifting over a surreal volcanic landscape.

destinations.name: Kaş
destinations.blurb: Laid-back Lycian harbour town with boutique stays, diving and boat trips to Kekova's sunken ruins.

destinations.name: Ephesus
destinations.blurb: Marble streets, the Library of Celsus and a vast theatre at one of the Mediterranean's great Roman cities.

destinations.name: Pamukkale
destinations.blurb: Brilliant white travertine terraces and thermal pools beside the ruins of ancient Hierapolis.

destinations.name: Dalyan
destinations.blurb: River cruises past Lycian rock tombs to Iztuzu Beach, a nesting ground for loggerhead turtles.

destinations.name: Funafuti
destinations.blurb: A skinny coral atoll of turquoise lagoon snorkelling, with a conservation area on the western side.

destinations.name: Taipei
destinations.blurb: Taipei 101, night markets, hot springs and dumplings, with mountain trails minutes from the centre.

destinations.name: Taroko Gorge
destinations.blurb: Marble canyon walls, tunnels, waterfalls and suspension bridges on Taiwan's wild east coast.

destinations.name: Sun Moon Lake
destinations.blurb: A misty mountain lake ringed by temples and tea plantations, best seen by bike or boat.

destinations.name: Tainan
destinations.blurb: Taiwan's oldest city, with Dutch forts, temples and some of the island's best street food.

destinations.name: Alishan
destinations.blurb: A mountain railway through giant cypress forests to a legendary sunrise over a sea of cloud.

destinations.name: Kenting
destinations.blurb: Tropical southern beaches, snorkelling and lighthouse headlands at the tip of Taiwan.

destinations.name: Jiufen
destinations.blurb: A lantern-draped old mining village of teahouses and steep alleys with sea views.

destinations.name: Serengeti National Park
destinations.blurb: Endless plains, big cats and the wildebeest migration in Tanzania's most famous park.

destinations.name: Ngorongoro Crater
destinations.blurb: A volcanic caldera floor packed with lions, rhinos and flamingos, with Maasai villages on the rim.

destinations.name: Mount Kilimanjaro
destinations.blurb: Africa's highest peak: a bucket-list climb, or a gentler day hike through forest on its lower slopes.

destinations.blurb: Giant baobabs and dry-season elephant herds along a river, quieter than the northern headline parks.

destinations.blurb: Boat and walking safaris on the Rufiji river among hippos and wild dogs, with few other visitors.

destinations.name: Ruaha National Park
destinations.blurb: Rugged, remote bush with big lion prides, kudu and baobab-studded hills.

destinations.name: Mafia Island
destinations.blurb: Quiet marine park with coral reefs, whale sharks (October to March) and hardly any crowds.

destinations.name: Stone Town
destinations.blurb: Labyrinthine alleys, carved doors, the old Sultan's palace and spice-scented rooftop sunsets (UNESCO).

destinations.name: Nungwi and Kendwa

destinations.name: Paje
destinations.blurb: Kitesurfing, huge tidal flats and seaweed farmers on the island's wide east-coast sands.

destinations.name: Jozani Forest
destinations.blurb: Rare red colobus monkeys and a mangrove boardwalk in Zanzibar's last big patch of forest.

destinations.name: Pemba Island
destinations.blurb: Clove plantations, dive walls and quiet reefs on a greener, far less visited sister island.

destinations.name: Bwindi Impenetrable National Park
destinations.blurb: Trekking to meet mountain gorillas in misty ancient rainforest.

destinations.name: Queen Elizabeth National Park
destinations.blurb: Tree-climbing lions in Ishasha, hippos along the Kazinga Channel and crater-lake scenery.

destinations.name: Murchison Falls National Park
destinations.blurb: Boat trips to the base of the thundering falls, then giraffe, lion and elephant safaris.

destinations.name: Kibale Forest National Park
destinations.blurb: One of the best places in Africa to track chimpanzees, with crater lakes nearby.

destinations.name: Lake Bunyonyi
destinations.blurb: Terraced hills, canoe trips and island lodges on a calm, tranquil lake.

destinations.name: Jinja
destinations.blurb: White-water rafting, kayaking and quad biking at the source of the Nile on Lake Victoria.

destinations.name: Lviv
destinations.blurb: A cobbled Habsburg-era centre of coffee houses and chocolate shops, western Ukraine's cultural jewel.

destinations.name: Kyiv
destinations.blurb: Golden-domed monasteries on the Dnipro hills and a lively Podil café scene.

destinations.name: Carpathian Mountains
destinations.blurb: Wooded peaks, Bukovel's ski slopes and Hutsul villages of wooden churches.

destinations.name: Odesa
destinations.blurb: A Black Sea port of grand opera house, the Potemkin Stairs and breezy seafront promenades.

destinations.name: Chernivtsi
destinations.blurb: A Habsburg-style university city with a UNESCO-listed red-brick campus.

destinations.name: Punta del Este
destinations.blurb: The South American Riviera: yacht harbour, sweeping beaches and the Casapueblo sunset.

destinations.name: Montevideo
destinations.blurb: Relaxed seafront capital with the Mercado del Puerto parrillas and a historic Ciudad Vieja.

destinations.name: Colonia del Sacramento
destinations.blurb: A Portuguese-era riverside town of cobbles, lighthouses and vintage cars.

destinations.name: Cabo Polonio
destinations.blurb: A car-free dune village with a lighthouse, sea lions and no mains electricity.

destinations.name: Jose Ignacio
destinations.blurb: Chic, understated fishing village with wild beaches and some of Uruguay's best restaurants.

destinations.name: Carmelo
destinations.blurb: Tannat vineyards and sleepy river life on the Rio de la Plata, a tranquil wine escape.

destinations.name: New York City
destinations.blurb: Broadway, Central Park, the Met and skyline views from the Empire State, all packed into a few brilliant days.

destinations.name: Orlando
destinations.blurb: Disney, Universal and wall-to-wall Florida sunshine, the great British theme-park pilgrimage.

destinations.name: Las Vegas
destinations.blurb: Neon, fountains, big-name shows and desert day trips to Red Rock Canyon and the Hoover Dam.

destinations.name: Los Angeles
destinations.blurb: Hollywood, Santa Monica pier, Malibu beaches and Griffith Observatory at sunset.

destinations.name: San Francisco
destinations.blurb: Golden Gate Bridge, cable cars, Alcatraz and superb food on the hills above the bay.

destinations.name: Miami and South Beach
destinations.blurb: Art deco streets, white sand and Latin nightlife, with the Everglades and the Keys on the doorstep.

destinations.name: Maui
destinations.blurb: Road to Hana waterfalls, sunrise on Haleakala volcano, golden beaches and whale watching offshore.

destinations.name: Grand Canyon
destinations.blurb: A mile-deep gorge glowing red at dawn, the great American road-trip centrepiece.

destinations.name: New Orleans
destinations.blurb: Live jazz on Frenchmen Street, beignets, Creole cooking and balconied French Quarter streets.

destinations.name: Napa and Sonoma
destinations.blurb: World-class cabernets, long lunches among the vines and cycling through golden valley light.

destinations.name: Samarkand
destinations.blurb: The turquoise-tiled Registan, Gur-e-Amir and the Shah-i-Zinda necropolis on the legendary Silk Road.

destinations.name: Bukhara
destinations.blurb: Trading domes, caravanserais and the Kalyan Minaret, in a remarkably intact old Silk Road city.

destinations.name: Khiva
destinations.blurb: A walled desert oasis of mud-brick lanes, painted minarets and carved wooden doors.

destinations.name: Tashkent
destinations.blurb: Soviet-era grandeur, a marvellous metro, the Chorsu Bazaar and the Khast Imam old quarter.

destinations.name: Fergana Valley
destinations.blurb: Silk workshops in Margilan, ceramics in Rishtan and bustling bazaars in a fertile valley.

destinations.name: Moynaq and the Aral Sea
destinations.blurb: Rusting ships stranded in the desert where the Aral Sea once lapped, a haunting off-the-beaten-track trip.

destinations.name: Chimgan and Charvak
destinations.blurb: Tian Shan peaks and a turquoise reservoir for hiking, ski-lifts and lakeside picnics near Tashkent.

destinations.name: St Peter's Basilica and the Vatican Museums
destinations.blurb: Michelangelo's Sistine Chapel, Raphael's rooms and Bernini's St Peter's Square.

destinations.name: Bequia
destinations.blurb: Easygoing Grenadine island of Admiralty Bay yachts, Princess Margaret Beach and a boat-building tradition.

destinations.name: Tobago Cays and Union Island
destinations.blurb: Snorkel with turtles in a horseshoe-reef marine park of tiny sandbars, then rum at Union Island's Happy Island bar.

destinations.name: Mustique
destinations.blurb: Private-island glamour, Basil's Bar, secluded beaches and villas where royalty and rock stars go to hide.

destinations.name: Saint Vincent
destinations.blurb: Rugged volcanic main island: La Soufrière hikes, black-sand beaches, Dark View Falls and old botanic gardens.

destinations.name: Angel Falls and Canaima
destinations.blurb: The world's tallest waterfall, reached by river and light aircraft over flat-topped tepuis.

destinations.name: Los Roques
destinations.blurb: A protected Caribbean archipelago of white sand, kitesurfing and bonefish flats.

destinations.name: Isla de Margarita
destinations.blurb: Venezuela's holiday island, with long beaches, lagoons and fresh seafood.

destinations.name: Merida and the Andes
destinations.blurb: A student city beneath snow-capped peaks, with Andean villages, trout lakes and big mountain views.

destinations.name: La Gran Sabana
destinations.blurb: Open savannah with table-top mountains and cascades, the landscape behind Roraima.

destinations.name: Choroni
destinations.blurb: A colonial Caribbean fishing village backed by cloud forest in Henri Pittier National Park.

destinations.name: Virgin Gorda
destinations.blurb: Scramble through the giant granite boulders and sea-filled grottoes of The Baths, then anchor in Gorda Sound.

destinations.name: Tortola
destinations.blurb: Cane Garden Bay's palm-fringed sweep, rum bars and hillside rainforest, with sailing yachts bobbing offshore.

destinations.name: Jost Van Dyke
destinations.blurb: Barefoot bliss at White Bay's Soggy Dollar Bar, where the Painkiller cocktail was born.

destinations.name: Anegada
destinations.blurb: Flat coral island of Loblolly Bay, flamingos, a vast horseshoe reef and fresh spiny lobster on the grill.

destinations.name: Norman Island
destinations.blurb: Treasure Island of legend: snorkel the Caves, anchor in The Bight and drop in on the floating Willy T bar.

destinations.name: St John
destinations.blurb: Mostly national park: Trunk Bay snorkel trail, hilly hikes and quiet white beaches a short ferry from St Thomas.

destinations.name: St Thomas
destinations.blurb: Mile-long Magens Bay, duty-free Charlotte Amalie and hillside harbour views; the easy gateway to the islands.

destinations.name: St Croix
destinations.blurb: Danish-colonial Christiansted, Buck Island's reef trail, rum distilleries and the slowest pace in the territory.

destinations.name: Hoi An
destinations.blurb: Lantern-lit ancient town, tailors who stitch a suit overnight and cycle rides to An Bang beach.

destinations.name: Hanoi
destinations.blurb: Old Quarter chaos, egg coffee, bun cha lunches and a hushed Temple of Literature around Hoan Kiem Lake.

destinations.name: Ha Long Bay
destinations.blurb: Overnight junk cruises among thousands of emerald limestone islets, with kayaking into hidden lagoons.

destinations.name: Ho Chi Minh City
destinations.blurb: Motorbike-buzzing Saigon with French colonial landmarks, the Cu Chi tunnels and superb street food.

destinations.name: Phu Quoc
destinations.blurb: Vietnam's largest island, with white-sand Sao Beach, pepper farms, night markets and warm turquoise sea.

destinations.name: Da Nang
destinations.blurb: Long city beaches, the Dragon Bridge and the Marble Mountains, plus the Golden Bridge at Ba Na Hills.

destinations.name: Sapa
destinations.blurb: Terraced rice paddies, hill-tribe villages and misty treks below Fansipan, Indochina's highest peak.

destinations.name: Ninh Binh
destinations.blurb: Rowing boats glide through limestone caves at Trang An, the 'Ha Long Bay on land'.

destinations.name: Hue
destinations.blurb: The Imperial Citadel, ornate emperors' tombs and pagodas beside the Perfume River.

destinations.name: Mekong Delta
destinations.blurb: Dawn floating markets, fruit orchards and boat trips along the canals of Vietnam's rice bowl.

destinations.name: Port Vila and Efate
destinations.blurb: Harbourside French-Melanesian capital with blue holes, a lively market and easy island resorts.

destinations.name: Tanna
destinations.blurb: Walk to the rim of Mount Yasur, one of the world's most accessible active volcanoes.

destinations.name: Espiritu Santo
destinations.blurb: Dive the SS President Coolidge wreck, then swim in the Champagne Beach shallows and blue holes.

destinations.name: Pentecost Island
destinations.blurb: Home of the original land-diving ritual, in which men leap from tall towers with vines tied to their ankles.

destinations.name: Wallis Island
destinations.blurb: Lake Lalolalo's sheer-walled crater, the Talietumu fortress ruins and a quiet lagoon with simple stays.

destinations.name: Futuna Island
destinations.blurb: Mountainous and traditional, with kava ceremonies, tapa cloth and rugged coastal walking.

destinations.name: Snowdonia (Eryri)
destinations.blurb: Wales's highest mountain, slate villages, castles and the Snowdon Mountain Railway to the summit.

destinations.name: Pembrokeshire Coast
destinations.blurb: Golden bays, puffin islands, the tiny cathedral city of St Davids and a wild coastal path.

destinations.name: Gower Peninsula
destinations.blurb: Britain's first Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty, with three-mile Rhossili Bay and Worm's Head.

destinations.name: Brecon Beacons (Bannau Brycheiniog)
destinations.blurb: Pen y Fan, waterfall country, dark skies and canalside Brecon.

destinations.name: Cardiff
destinations.blurb: Cardiff Castle, the Principality Stadium, the Bay and Victorian arcades full of independent shops.

destinations.name: Anglesey
destinations.blurb: Island of sandy beaches and a coastal path, with Beaumaris Castle, South Stack lighthouse and Llanfairpwll.

destinations.name: Llandudno and Conwy
destinations.blurb: Victorian seaside resort with a pier and the Great Orme tramway, next to Conwy's perfect medieval castle.

destinations.name: Portmeirion
destinations.blurb: Italianate pastel village on the Dwyryd estuary, built by Clough Williams-Ellis and made famous by The Prisoner.

destinations.name: Llŷn Peninsula
destinations.blurb: Remote, Welsh-speaking peninsula of surf beaches, Abersoch sailing and a pub on the sand at Porthdinllaen.

destinations.name: Cardigan Bay
destinations.blurb: Dolphin-watching coast of painted Georgian harbour houses at Aberaeron and New Quay.

destinations.name: Lalomanu and the south coast
destinations.blurb: Powder sand, open-sided beach fales and the To Sua Ocean Trench, a swimming hole carved by the sea.

destinations.name: Savai'i
destinations.blurb: Wild lava fields, blowholes, waterfalls and village life on Polynesia's biggest island.

destinations.name: Apia
destinations.blurb: A friendly waterfront capital with the Robert Louis Stevenson Museum and a lively fish market.

destinations.name: Socotra Island
destinations.blurb: A remote UNESCO island of dragon's blood trees, white dunes and rare wildlife in the Arabian Sea.

destinations.name: Shibam Hadramawt
destinations.blurb: Known as the Manhattan of the desert: 16th-century mud-brick skyscrapers rising from the wadi.

destinations.name: Sana'a Old City
destinations.blurb: A UNESCO old city of multi-storey gingerbread-style houses, mosques and souks.

destinations.name: Haraz Mountains (Manakha)
destinations.blurb: Terraced hillsides and fortified mountain villages in the highlands west of the capital.

destinations.name: Cape Town
destinations.blurb: Table Mountain, Cape Point drives, penguins at Boulders Beach and a world-class waterfront food scene.

destinations.name: Kruger National Park
destinations.blurb: Big Five game drives and bush lodges across a reserve nearly the size of Wales.

destinations.name: Garden Route
destinations.blurb: Forested lagoons, Knysna oysters, Plettenberg Bay beaches and Tsitsikamma gorges along a spectacular coast road.

destinations.name: Cape Winelands
destinations.blurb: Stellenbosch, Franschhoek and Paarl: Cape Dutch estates, mountain-ringed vineyards and long lunches.

destinations.name: Hermanus and the Whale Coast
destinations.blurb: Whale watching from the cliff path (June to November), with great white shark diving at nearby Gansbaai.

destinations.name: Addo Elephant National Park
destinations.blurb: Malaria-free safari with huge elephant herds, lions and a marine section where whales and dolphins pass.

destinations.name: Drakensberg
destinations.blurb: Towering basalt walls, big hikes, San rock art and cosy mountain lodges below the Lesotho border.

destinations.name: iSimangaliso Wetland Park
destinations.blurb: Hippo boat trips, turtle-nesting beaches and Big Five safaris on a World Heritage coast.

destinations.name: Route 62 and the Little Karoo
destinations.blurb: Quirky Karoo villages, Cango Caves, ostrich farms and a winding scenic road to the Garden Route.

destinations.name: Johannesburg and Soweto
destinations.blurb: The Apartheid Museum, Nelson Mandela's Soweto home and a lively street-art and restaurant scene.

destinations.name: Livingstone and Victoria Falls
destinations.blurb: The Zambian side of the Falls: swim in Devil's Pool, take a Zambezi sunset cruise and cross the Knife-Edge Bridge.

destinations.name: South Luangwa National Park
destinations.blurb: Walking safaris, night drives and leopards in the birthplace of the walking safari.

destinations.name: Lower Zambezi National Park
destinations.blurb: Canoe safaris and fishing past elephants and hippos on the Zambezi, opposite Mana Pools.

destinations.name: Kafue National Park
destinations.blurb: Zambia's biggest park: wild, uncrowded bush with leopards, lechwe and rare sitatunga.

destinations.name: Siavonga and Lake Kariba
destinations.blurb: Houseboats, tiger-fishing and sunsets over one of the world's largest man-made lakes.

destinations.name: Victoria Falls
destinations.blurb: The Smoke that Thunders: the Falls themselves, plus bungee, white-water rafting and Zambezi sunset cruises.

destinations.name: Hwange National Park
destinations.blurb: Huge elephant herds at waterholes in Zimbabwe's biggest park, with hides and walking safaris.

destinations.name: Mana Pools National Park
destinations.blurb: Walk among elephants and lions on the Zambezi floodplain in a UNESCO wilderness.

destinations.name: Matobo Hills
destinations.blurb: Balancing granite boulders, San rock paintings, rhino tracking and Cecil Rhodes's grave.

destinations.name: Lake Kariba
destinations.blurb: Houseboats, fishing and elephants drinking on the shore of a vast Zambezi lake.

destinations.name: Great Zimbabwe
destinations.blurb: The mighty stone ruins of a medieval African city that gave the country its name.

destinations.name: Eastern Highlands
destinations.blurb: Misty peaks, Mutarazi Falls, trout lakes and cool hill walks near the Mozambique border.
